projectBrief.whatAreWeBuilding: A complete library management app that organizes books and registered members, tracks active loans, enforces borrowing limits, and lets users search the catalog by title or author.

realWorldScenario.headline: City Public Library Catalog & Loan Engine
realWorldScenario.story: The municipal library needs a digitized circulation manager. Patrons register as library members, browse a collection of physical books, borrow up to their allowed quota, and return titles. The system must guarantee that a book cannot be borrowed twice simultaneously and members never exceed their quota.
realWorldScenario.context: Resource management systems in software engineering (rentals, reservations, inventory) all follow the fundamental composition patterns modeled in this system.

functional: Create a Book class with fields: isbn, title, author, and isAvailable flag. Implement borrowBook() and returnBook().
Create a Member class with fields: memberId, name, and borrowedBooks list (capped at maximum 3 books).
Create a Library class that composes a list of Book objects and a list of Member objects.
Implement addBook(Book b) and registerMember(Member m) in Library.
Implement searchByTitle(String query) and searchByAuthor(String query) returning matching books.
Implement issueBook(String isbn, String memberId) that checks book availability and member quota before transferring possession.
Implement returnBook(String isbn, String memberId) that marks the book available and removes it from the member's borrowed list.
Provide printCatalogStatus() and printMemberLoans(String memberId).
technicalConstraints: Book must not be issued if isAvailable is false.
Member must not be allowed to borrow more than 3 books concurrently.
issueBook must safely handle non-existent ISBNs or Member IDs without crashing.
Defensive copying: getBorrowedBooks() in Member must return an unmodifiable list or shallow copy to prevent external tampering.
userDecisions: Decide whether to add publication year or genre categories to Book.
Choose loan duration or overdue fine calculation logic.

outputsRequired: Search result listings matching keyword queries
Loan transaction status ('Book successfully checked out')
Formatted member active loan report and inventory summary
conditionalLogic: quota check: if (member.getBorrowedBooksCount() >= MAX_LOANS) return false
loopStructures: Linear search loops through catalog finding matches by title or ISBN
Iteration through borrowed books when printing loan summaries
recommendedMethods: public boolean issueBook(String isbn, String memberId)
public boolean returnBook(String isbn, String memberId)

tasks: Implement Book with isbn, title, author, isAvailable.
Implement Member with memberId, name, borrowedBooks list.

Add addBorrowedBook(Book b) and removeBorrowedBook(Book b).
acceptanceCriteria: Book toggles availability cleanly; Member limits loans to 3 maximum.

buildRoadmap.objective: Build Library composing collections of Books and Members.
tasks: Declare List<Book> catalog and List<Member> members in Library.
Implement addBook() and registerMember().
Implement searchByTitle(query) and searchByAuthor(query) case-insensitively.
Implement findBookByIsbn(isbn) and findMemberById(id) helper methods.
acceptanceCriteria: Books and Members can be added and searched accurately by keyword.

buildRoadmap.title: Loan Transaction Coordination
buildRoadmap.objective: Implement issueBook and returnBook orchestrating state across Book and Member.
tasks: In issueBook(isbn, memberId): locate book and member; verify availability and quota.
Call book.borrowBook() and member.addBorrowedBook(book).
In returnBook(isbn, memberId): verify member holds book, call book.returnBook() and member.removeBorrowedBook(book).
acceptanceCriteria: Checked-out book becomes unavailable in catalog and appears in member loans; return reverses state cleanly.

buildRoadmap.title: Library Simulation & Audit Driver
buildRoadmap.objective: Simulate full library lifecycle in LibraryAppMain.
tasks: Add 5 books and 2 members.
Simulate normal checkout, quota overflow (attempting 4th book), and double checkout of same book.
Verify active loan audits and catalog status.
acceptanceCriteria: Driver runs all scenarios successfully, proving multi-entity composition.

thinkBeforeYouCode.question: What is the difference between Composition and Inheritance?
thinkBeforeYouCode.mentorInsight: Inheritance represents an 'Is-A' relationship (Developer is an Employee). Composition represents a 'Has-A' relationship (Library has Books, Member has BorrowedBooks). Composition is generally preferred because it creates flexible, loosely-coupled systems.

thinkBeforeYouCode.question: Why shouldn't Member.getBorrowedBooks() return the direct internal list reference?
thinkBeforeYouCode.mentorInsight: If you return the direct reference, any external caller can do member.getBorrowedBooks().clear(), wiping out the member's borrowing records without updating the Books' availability in the library. Always return an unmodifiable list or defensive copy.

thinkBeforeYouCode.question: How does issueBook coordinate state across multiple objects?
thinkBeforeYouCode.mentorInsight: The Library acts as the mediator: it finds the Book, finds the Member, checks invariants on both, and updates both in a single coordinated operation, ensuring that book.isAvailable and member.borrowedBooks stay perfectly in sync.

hintSystem.level1Conceptual: Check member's current borrowed count before allowing another checkout.
hintSystem.level2Implementation: If member.getBorrowedCount() >= 3, reject checkout with an informative error.

hintSystem.level1Conceptual: Flip book state and append to member list together.

normalCases: Member borrows available Book -> Book becomes unavailable; appears in member loans
Member returns borrowed Book -> Book becomes available again; removed from member loans
Search 'Clean' -> Returns 'Clean Code' by Robert Martin
boundaryCases: Member borrows exactly 3 books (maximum allowed quota) -> Succeeds on 3rd book
Searching for a book that is currently checked out -> Found in catalog with status [BORROWED]
invalidInputCases: Attempting to borrow a 4th book when already holding 3 -> Rejected with quota error
Attempting to borrow a book that is already checked out -> Rejected with unavailable error
Attempting to return a book the member does not hold -> Rejected with mismatch error
edgeCases: Returning all 3 books resets member loan count to 0, allowing 3 fresh checkouts

debuggingGuide: Book borrowed by one member showing in another member's list: Verify that each Member maintains their own independent new ArrayList<Book>() instance.
NullPointerException in issueBook: Ensure findBookByIsbn and findMemberById check for null before dereferencing.
String comparison failing in search: Always use title.toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase()) for case-insensitive matching.
ConcurrentModificationException: If removing a book from a list while iterating, use an Iterator or search-and-remove by index.

Add clear status flags ([AVAILABLE] vs [CHECKED OUT]).
Print a formatted checkout receipt with due date reminder.

# Library Management System (Java OOP)

## Overview
A multi-entity library circulation and catalog engine built in Java demonstrating object composition, aggregation ('Has-A' relationships), and coordinated state transitions across Books, Members, and Library aggregates.

## Entity Relationship Diagram
```
+-----------------------+              +-----------------------+
|        Library        |              |        Member         |
+-----------------------+              +-----------------------+
| - catalog: List<Book> |<>----------->| - memberId: String    |
| - members: List<Member>              | - name: String        |
+-----------------------+              | - borrowedBooks: List |
| + addBook(...)        |              +-----------------------+
| + issueBook(...)      |                         | Has-A (0..3)
| + returnBook(...)     |                         v
| + searchByTitle(...)  |              +-----------------------+
+-----------------------+              |         Book          |
            |                          +-----------------------+
            | Has-A (0..N)             | - isbn: String        |
            +------------------------->| - title: String       |
                                       | - author: String      |
                                       | - isAvailable: boolean|
                                       +-----------------------+
```

## Core OOP Principles Mastered
- **Composition & Aggregation**: Library aggregates Books and Members cleanly.
- **State Synchronization**: `issueBook` and `returnBook` maintain bidirectional consistency.
- **Defensive Encapsulation**: Members cannot exceed a 3-book loan quota; external code cannot corrupt loan lists.
- **Search Queries**: Multi-attribute linear search across catalog inventory.

## How to Run
```bash
javac Book.java Member.java Library.java LibraryApp.java
java LibraryApp
```

## Sample Catalog Status
```text
=========================================================================================
                                CITY LIBRARY CATALOG                                     
=========================================================================================
ISBN            Title                                Author              Status          
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
978-0134685991  Effective Java                       Joshua Bloch        [AVAILABLE]     
978-0132350884  Clean Code                           Robert C. Martin    [BORROWED]      
978-0596009205  Head First Design Patterns           Eric Freeman        [AVAILABLE]     
=========================================================================================
```

State coordination (Book availability, Member loan list, Library catalog)
Collection management and linear search algorithms
Defensive reference management to prevent data corruption
projectBrief.motivatingQuote: Mastering composition is the transition from writing small classes to architecting entire software systems.

realWorldScenario.headline: City Public Library Catalog & Loan Engine
realWorldScenario.story: The municipal library needs a digitized circulation manager. Patrons register as library members, browse a collection of physical books, borrow up to their allowed quota, and return titles. The system must guarantee that a book cannot be borrowed twice simultaneously and members never exceed their quota.
realWorldScenario.context: Resource management systems in software engineering (rentals, reservations, inventory) all follow the fundamental composition patterns modeled in this system.

functional: Create a Book class with fields: isbn, title, author, and isAvailable flag. Implement borrowBook() and returnBook().
Create a Member class with fields: memberId, name, and borrowedBooks list (capped at maximum 3 books).
Create a Library class that composes a list of Book objects and a list of Member objects.
Implement addBook(Book b) and registerMember(Member m) in Library.
Implement searchByTitle(String query) and searchByAuthor(String query) returning matching books.
Implement issueBook(String isbn, String memberId) that checks book availability and member quota before transferring possession.
Implement returnBook(String isbn, String memberId) that marks the book available and removes it from the member's borrowed list.
Provide printCatalogStatus() and printMemberLoans(String memberId).
technicalConstraints: Book must not be issued if isAvailable is false.
Member must not be allowed to borrow more than 3 books concurrently.
issueBook must safely handle non-existent ISBNs or Member IDs without crashing.
Defensive copying: getBorrowedBooks() in Member must return an unmodifiable list or shallow copy to prevent external tampering.
userDecisions: Decide whether to add publication year or genre categories to Book.
Choose loan duration or overdue fine calculation logic.

outputsRequired: Search result listings matching keyword queries
Loan transaction status ('Book successfully checked out')
Formatted member active loan report and inventory summary
conditionalLogic: quota check: if (member.getBorrowedBooksCount() >= MAX_LOANS) return false
loopStructures: Linear search loops through catalog finding matches by title or ISBN
Iteration through borrowed books when printing loan summaries
recommendedMethods: public boolean issueBook(String isbn, String memberId)
public boolean returnBook(String isbn, String memberId)

thinkBeforeYouCode.question: What is the difference between Composition and Inheritance?
thinkBeforeYouCode.mentorInsight: Inheritance represents an 'Is-A' relationship (Developer is an Employee). Composition represents a 'Has-A' relationship (Library has Books, Member has BorrowedBooks). Composition is generally preferred because it creates flexible, loosely-coupled systems.

thinkBeforeYouCode.question: Why shouldn't Member.getBorrowedBooks() return the direct internal list reference?
thinkBeforeYouCode.mentorInsight: If you return the direct reference, any external caller can do member.getBorrowedBooks().clear(), wiping out the member's borrowing records without updating the Books' availability in the library. Always return an unmodifiable list or defensive copy.

thinkBeforeYouCode.question: How does issueBook coordinate state across multiple objects?
thinkBeforeYouCode.mentorInsight: The Library acts as the mediator: it finds the Book, finds the Member, checks invariants on both, and updates both in a single coordinated operation, ensuring that book.isAvailable and member.borrowedBooks stay perfectly in sync.

normalCases: Member borrows available Book -> Book becomes unavailable; appears in member loans
Member returns borrowed Book -> Book becomes available again; removed from member loans
Search 'Clean' -> Returns 'Clean Code' by Robert Martin
boundaryCases: Member borrows exactly 3 books (maximum allowed quota) -> Succeeds on 3rd book
Searching for a book that is currently checked out -> Found in catalog with status [BORROWED]
invalidInputCases: Attempting to borrow a 4th book when already holding 3 -> Rejected with quota error
Attempting to borrow a book that is already checked out -> Rejected with unavailable error
Attempting to return a book the member does not hold -> Rejected with mismatch error
edgeCases: Returning all 3 books resets member loan count to 0, allowing 3 fresh checkouts

debuggingGuide: Book borrowed by one member showing in another member's list: Verify that each Member maintains their own independent new ArrayList<Book>() instance.
NullPointerException in issueBook: Ensure findBookByIsbn and findMemberById check for null before dereferencing.
String comparison failing in search: Always use title.toLowerCase().contains(query.toLowerCase()) for case-insensitive matching.
ConcurrentModificationException: If removing a book from a list while iterating, use an Iterator or search-and-remove by index.

# Library Management System (Java OOP)

## Overview
A multi-entity library circulation and catalog engine built in Java demonstrating object composition, aggregation ('Has-A' relationships), and coordinated state transitions across Books, Members, and Library aggregates.

## Entity Relationship Diagram
```
+-----------------------+              +-----------------------+
|        Library        |              |        Member         |
+-----------------------+              +-----------------------+
| - catalog: List<Book> |<>----------->| - memberId: String    |
| - members: List<Member>              | - name: String        |
+-----------------------+              | - borrowedBooks: List |
| + addBook(...)        |              +-----------------------+
| + issueBook(...)      |                         | Has-A (0..3)
| + returnBook(...)     |                         v
| + searchByTitle(...)  |              +-----------------------+
+-----------------------+              |         Book          |
            |                          +-----------------------+
            | Has-A (0..N)             | - isbn: String        |
            +------------------------->| - title: String       |
                                       | - author: String      |
                                       | - isAvailable: boolean|
                                       +-----------------------+
```

## Core OOP Principles Mastered
- **Composition & Aggregation**: Library aggregates Books and Members cleanly.
- **State Synchronization**: `issueBook` and `returnBook` maintain bidirectional consistency.
- **Defensive Encapsulation**: Members cannot exceed a 3-book loan quota; external code cannot corrupt loan lists.
- **Search Queries**: Multi-attribute linear search across catalog inventory.

## How to Run
```bash
javac Book.java Member.java Library.java LibraryApp.java
java LibraryApp
```

## Sample Catalog Status
```text
=========================================================================================
                                CITY LIBRARY CATALOG                                     
=========================================================================================
ISBN            Title                                Author              Status          
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
978-0134685991  Effective Java                       Joshua Bloch        [AVAILABLE]     
978-0132350884  Clean Code                           Robert C. Martin    [BORROWED]      
978-0596009205  Head First Design Patterns           Eric Freeman        [AVAILABLE]     
=========================================================================================
```
